recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray #E8E8E8 (all positions below are percentages of slide width x / height y).
2. Title: add text box 'Example' at x=5-20%, y=8-18%; color #C00000, bold serif, largest text on the slide.
3. Kicker: add rectangle filled #F8CBAD at x=5-18%, y=16-20% (directly below the title) containing 'Bad Weights' in black #000000 small sans-serif.
4. Slide number: add circle filled #FFD966 with black outline in the top-right corner (approx x=92-98%, y=3-10%) containing '30' in black.
5. Diagram frame: add rectangle with white #FFFFFF fill and red #C00000 border spanning x=20-88%, y=10-45%; it contains the network built in steps 6-11.
6. Inputs: at the left edge inside the frame, add black labels 'x1' (upper) and 'x2' (lower); to their left add a vertical bracket grouping black values '[7]' (aligned with x1) and '[4]' (aligned with x2).
7. Hidden layer: add a vertical column of three circles filled #FFE699 at the frame center, labeled '3', '4', '5' top-to-bottom in black; directly above each circle place blue #0000FF labels 'O3', 'O4', 'O5' respectively.
8. Output layer: add a vertical column of two circles filled #F4B183 to the right of the hidden column, labeled '6' (top) and '7' (bottom) in black; above them place blue #0000FF labels 'O6' and 'O7'.
9. Input-to-hidden connections: draw lines x1->3, x1->4, x1->5, x2->3, x2->4, x2->5 and label the weights in black: 0.1 (x1->3), 0.2 (x1->4), 0.3 (x1->5), 0.4 (x2->3), 0.5 (x2->4), 0.6 (x2->5).
10. Hidden-to-output connections: draw lines from nodes 3, 4, 5 to both outputs 6 and 7; label them in red #FF0000: 0.3 from node 3, 0.4 from node 4, 0.5 from node 5 (the same three weights feed both outputs, matching Net6 = Net7).
11. Targets: at the far right of the frame add black column headers 'Output' (above the O6/O7 column) and 'Target' (rightmost); under 'Target' place '[0]' on the t6 row and '[1]' on the t7 row with black row labels 't6' and 't7'; connect O6 to the [0]/t6 row and O7 to the [1]/t7 row with dashed lines.
12. Header: add text 'Forward' at x=5-18%, y=45-50% in blue #0000FF italic serif.
13. Blue box 1: add rectangle, white fill, blue #0000FF border, at x=5-37%, y=50-68%, with three black sans-serif lines, leading token in red #C00000: 'Net3 = 7 * 0.1 + 4 * 0.4 = 2.3' / 'Net4 = 7 * 0.2 + 4 * 0.5 = 3.4' / 'Net5 = 7 * 0.3 + 4 * 0.6 = 4.5'.
14. Blue box 2: add rectangle, white fill, blue #0000FF border, at x=5-62%, y=68-92%, with two lines ('Net6' and 'Net7' in red #C00000, rest black): 'Net6 = 0.909 * 0.3 + 0.968 * 0.4 + 0.989 * 0.5 = 1.1544' / 'Net7 = 0.909 * 0.3 + 0.968 * 0.4 + 0.989 * 0.5 = 1.1544'.
15. Green box 1: add rectangle, white fill, green #00B050 border, at x=66-95%, y=50-68%, with three lines ('O3', 'O4', 'O5' in red #C00000, rest black): 'O3 = 1 / (1 + e^-2.3) = 0.909' / 'O4 = 1 / (1 + e^-3.4) = 0.968' / 'O5 = 1 / (1 + e^-4.5) = 0.989'.
16. Green box 2: add rectangle, white fill, green #00B050 border, at x=66-95%, y=68-92%, with two lines ('O6' and 'O7' in red #C00000, rest black): 'O6 = 1 / (1 + e^-1.1544) = 0.76' / 'O7 = 1 / (1 + e^-1.1544) = 0.76'.
